about: The street-lighting standard (docs/world-standards/towns.md): every town street and every road near a town carries lanterns. Read by tools/town-lights.mts (plan/check/apply) and by `zonegen status` (row `town <name>: lights`). Schema with every field described: streetLightingSchema in tools/town-lights-rule.mts. A project may replace this file with authoring/street-lights.json. `profiles` is the wealth/size factor: the first whose `when` matches the town (plan tier; plan wealth, else the residents' median) is merged over the base.

profiles.name: poor-village
profiles.about: Hamlets and villages whose folk are poor burn little oil: one lantern at each gate, one where each lane leaves the street, one at the alehouse/inn door; the street, the green and the roads out stay dark.

profiles.name: village
profiles.about: Comfortable villages: street lanterns twice as far apart, lanes lit where they leave the street, a lantern at the alehouse/inn, no lanterns on the roads out.
